purpose: Owner-approved user-facing DR improvements that must remain in the independent app and block FULL_IDENTICAL until LIVE is intentionally upgraded to match.

entries.live_sync_target: Bring LIVE customer profiles up to the richer DR customer command-center behavior without removing DR functionality.
